options.name: The Career Map, Checkpoint by Checkpoint
options.carrier: one horizontal route with five milestone nodes, drawn once in beat 2 and annotated for the rest of the lesson
options.primary_risk: density — by beat 13 the checkpoint carries eleven attached objects and overlapping text is a fatal inspector finding; mitigated by reserved lanes per attachment type and a four-word cap on attached copy

options.name: The 90-Day Anchor Card
options.carrier: a single index card centre-frame that accumulates written lines and margin annotations
options.primary_risk: the card can only express ideas as text inside a fixed rectangle, so journey, checkpoint, progress and branching all degrade into small type

decision: A — the map is the script's own metaphor ('the mid-career checkpoint in your career map'), it has a place for all seven movements, and it keeps one object on screen for the whole runtime instead of redrawing the frame each beat.
